Coram : ABHAY S. OKA*, PANKAJ MITHAL
Issue for Consideration Issue arose as regards the treatment to be given to broken period interest, whether a deduction of the broken period interest can be claimed by the Bank, purchaser of the government Securities. Headnotes† Income Tax Act, 1961 – s.28 – Interest on Maturity (HTM) government securities – Interest for the broken period, if allowed as a deduction: Held: As the securities were treated as stock-in-trade, the interest on the broken period cannot be considered as capital expenditure and will have to be treated as revenue expenditure, which
